I'm on a spot-price electricity contract. Please schedule these appliance cycles for 2022-08-08 so that my electricity cost is as low as possible, without exceeding my household peak load limit:
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 09:45, must finish by 17:45
- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 07:00, must finish by 15:45

results.label: Multi-Agent Pipeline
results.message: Your appliances are scheduled to run at the same time for optimal efficiency! The dishwasher will start at 11:00 and finish by 17:45, while the washing machine will also run at 11:00 and finish by 15:45. The estimated cost for this schedule is low, and it stays within your household peak load limit. Enjoy your clean dishes and laundry!
